meta.name: x-nets
meta.description:
Enhanced netstat module with cached data and structured output.
View network connections, routing tables, and interface statistics
in interactive or TSV/CSV formats.

**Dependency**: This is an x-cmd module. Install x-cmd first (see x-cmd skill for installation options).
see x-cmd skill for installation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查看网络连接、路由表和接口统计
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要命令行下查看网络状态并导出结构化数据
copy.tagline_en: View network connections, routing tables, and interface statistics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to inspect network state and export structured data from the command line

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以运行 x nets 命令来查看网络连接、路由表和接口统计信息，支持交互式查看或导出为 TSV/CSV 格式。
howto.when: 当用户要求查看网络连接、路由表或接口统计信息时触发。

say.text: 显示当前的网络连接列表。
把路由表导出为 CSV 文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can run x nets commands to view network connections, routing tables, and interface statistics, with options for interactive viewing or TSV/CSV export.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to view network connections, routing tables, or interface statistics.

say_en.note: Claude will run x nets view internet.

say_en.text: Export the routing table as a CSV file.
say_en.note: Claude will run x nets view --csv route.
